key_insight: Stabilized isogeometric topology optimization combines trimmed geometry representations with a generalized Cahn–Hilliard model to optimize structures without sensitivity analysis.
engineering_relevance: The method supports minimum-compliance structural design on complex domains while accommodating material constraints, topology changes, and non-design regions.
method: Evolve a fourth-order generalized Cahn–Hilliard PDE toward steady-state optimized structures.
Apply Nitsche’s formulation with minimal stabilization to impose Dirichlet conditions and address trimming-induced instability.
Extend the immersed boundary-conformal method to complex non-design domains and unified material–void interface treatment.
evidence_signal: A three-dimensional biharmonic problem and several two-dimensional topology optimization examples demonstrate effectiveness, stability, and geometric flexibility.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish three-dimensional topology optimization performance or computational scaling.
paper_title: Stabilized Isogeometric Topology Optimization on Trimmed Geometries
